connector.name: MCP Fhir
connector.registryDescription: FHIR R4 read/search/validate MCP server - US Core/IPS profiles, SMART-on-FHIR auth (Epic/Cerner).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-fhir. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pcmedsinge account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: FHIR_BASE_URL

env.name: SMART_ENABLED
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable SMART-on-FHIR OAuth 2.0 (Epic/Cerner)
